title: Normal relaxation lowers energy without producing a negative witness
statement: Fix smooth actual S=M+Hesspsi and w=|S|^2 bounded AWAY from0,on its fixed Hessian-Hodge fiber. For smooth mean-zeroz,E_z=-J Hess Delta^-1z is the unique normal corrector on that fiber. For each FIXEDz,lim_a->infty a[<F_a(S+E_z/a)>-<H(S)>]=<K_S z>+2delta<wz^2>,K_S=Delta^-1 div div[J DF0(S)],zero mode removed. This includes actual symmetric Hodge response,not just pointwise normal derivative. ell=<K_S/w>/<1/w>,z*=-(K_S-ell)/(4delta w) is smooth,mean-zero,genuinely compatible and ATTAINS -<(K_S-ell)^2/w>/(8delta),negative iff K nonconstant. This is an infimum of FIXED-CORRECTOR limits,not limit-infimum interchange or attainment when w vanishes. One-dimensional S=[[cosx,1],[1,0]] gives k2=(2r+1)/[2(r+2)] and exact cost -k2^2(5/2-sqrt6)/(8delta);finite Fourier trial also negative. Two-dimensional S=I+Hess[(cosx+cosy+cos(x+y))/10] has eigenvalues>=3/5;source constructs full16-frequency-pair forcing/adjoint and rational uncorrected descent. CORRECTION:in normalized ORIGINAL F0=Jr(T_rB)/(kappa sigma^2),r3/4,meanB=I,Jensen gap falls .1151013950234 to .0848937259455 (~26.2444%),while TOTAL energy falls3.3549025840941 to3.3246949150162 (~0.9004%). Gap remains POSITIVE. Earlier26%-total-energy wording is historical/incorrect,not current interpretation. Received coordinator checker reruns passed at their reported scope,not independent analytic audit or Capital replay.
